title: Lottie
summary: Vector accents and widgets in the theme style, generated from code in lottie/generate.mjs: status widgets, reactions, data accents, pointers, reveals and looping backgrounds.

items.name: Reticle spin
items.description: Counter-rotating arcs around a pulsing point: targeting, thinking, loading.

items.name: Ping
items.description: Diamond waves radiating from a point: “here”, “live”, “detected”.

items.name: Signal bars
items.description: An equaliser of bars rising and falling: audio, activity, signal.

items.name: Access granted
items.description: A hexagon draws, flashes and a checkmark locks in.

items.name: Loader orbit
items.description: Arcs counter-rotating around a pulsing hexagon with two satellites in orbit (loop): loading, processing, standing by.

items.name: Loader segments
items.description: A ring of twelve segments with a light chasing round it (loop): working, buffering.

items.name: Radar sweep
items.description: A radar dial whose sweep lights up blips as it passes (loop): searching, scanning, detecting.

items.name: Countdown ring
items.description: 3-2-1-0 in seven-segment digits inside a draining ring, ending in an amber burst.

items.name: Progress bar
items.description: A notched bar fills in three pushes, flashes and ticks itself done: progress, stages, complete.

items.name: Power up
items.description: A power symbol switches on with a drop, a burst of rays and a ring: start, activate, online.

items.name: Toggle on
items.description: A switch slides across with a squash and lights up: enabled, turned on, a setting.

items.name: Lock secure
items.description: An open padlock snaps shut, lights up and is sealed in a hexagon: secured, private, encrypted.

items.name: Signal wave
items.description: Three layered waveforms travelling through a window, with a marker riding the main one (loop): audio, signal, voice.

items.name: Scan brackets
items.description: Corner brackets that breathe while a beam scans up and down (loop): analysing, scanning a subject.

items.name: Check glitch
items.description: A ring draws, a checkmark snaps in with a split-second glitch and a burst: yes, correct, done.

items.name: Cross denied
items.description: An octagon draws, a red cross slams in and the whole thing shakes: no, wrong, denied.

items.name: Warning flash
items.description: An amber warning triangle with echoing outlines and marching hazard stripes (loop): caution, risk.

items.name: Upload
items.description: An arrow rising out of a tray with chevrons streaming up behind it (loop): send, publish, export.

items.name: Download
items.description: An arrow dropping into a tray with chevrons streaming down (loop): receive, save, import.

items.name: Level up
items.description: A star pops in with overshoot, sparks and rising chevrons: achievement, upgrade, win.

items.name: Data transfer
items.description: Packets travelling between two hexagon nodes, with replies coming back (loop): sync, exchange, API calls.

items.name: Hex assemble
items.description: Six cells fly in around an amber core and lock into a honeycomb inside a shell: building, modules, a team.

items.name: Gauge dial
items.description: A dial whose arc and needle swing up, overshoot and settle near the red zone: performance, load, level (no numbers shown).

items.name: Orbit atoms
items.description: Three electrons on tilted orbits around a pulsing nucleus (loop): science, the core, a system in motion.

items.name: Pulse line
items.description: A heartbeat trace running across a grid (loop): alive, monitoring, a spike.

items.name: Pointer chevrons
items.description: Three chevrons rippling toward a pinging target (loop): look here, next, this way.

items.name: Callout line
items.description: A point pings, a leader line draws out and a label plate builds with placeholder text bars: annotation, detail.

items.name: Target lock
items.description: Wedges close in, crosshairs draw and the reticle locks amber: focus, found it, the key point.

items.name: Ring emphasis
items.description: A ring draws round the centre with a second arc, ticks and an underline: circle this, emphasis.

items.name: Wipe bars
items.description: Seven bars sweep in from the left and out to the right, staggered: a wipe between beats (ends empty).

items.name: Iris hex
items.description: A hexagon floods the frame, then opens from the centre with echo rings: an iris reveal (ends empty).

items.name: Frame reveal
items.description: A notched frame draws on and a scan beam uncovers a grid inside it: introducing a panel or a section.

items.name: Grid pulse
items.description: A grid with square pulses spreading from the centre and cells lighting up (loop): a quiet tech backdrop.

items.name: Scan lines
items.description: Horizontal lines with bright bands sweeping through and the odd glitch line (loop): monitor, surveillance.

items.name: Particle drift
items.description: Small diamonds and dots drifting upward and swaying (loop): calm ambient motion.
